summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 earnings press release dated November 4, 2026. Results showed revenue of $836 million on 195,018 ounces sold at a $4,289/oz realized price, production of 193,321 ounces, and AISC of $2,602/oz sold, with full-year AISC guidance lowered to $2,230–$2,410/oz. The company returned $59 million via $26 million dividends and $33 million of NCIB buybacks and declared a $0.02 quarterly dividend payable December 15, 2026. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
